page.layout: One printed page of numbered theses in one column, with running head and page number at the top right. Fragments of a facing page are cut off at the left edge (outer margin, not transcribed). Signature "B 2" at the foot.

main_text.l: 43 Finis proprie est in intentione, eo-
tur ad causam aliquam per se.
45 Causa per accidens agit, & suâ vi
agit, sed non principaliter suâ vi, quoad
etiam naturalis potest cogi, & potest agere
48 Ita tamen agit, ut per se fit indiffe-
rens ad hoc aut illud agendum.
iectum; respectu formæ est quasi subjectum.

page.notes: Left edge shows cut-off fragments of the facing page (e.g. "effa", "quod", "ur in", "caus", "plur", "con", "tribu", "Cau"); not transcribed. Several words in the left-hand lines are obscured by the binding shadow and are uncertain; e.g. "obiectum" in thesis 50 is a reading of the scan ("ob-jectum") and may be wrong; "agit" in 45 and "suâ vi" are uncertain.
